Wall segments are straight centerlines. Pascal supports curved walls via curve property. Parent: LevelNode.

mappings.vision5d: Floor polygon (derived from exterior wall loop)
mappings.notes: Polygon derived from outermost wall segments. Parent: LevelNode.

provenance_strategy.storage: Every Pascal node stores Vision 5D origin in metadata.vision5d
provenance_strategy.round_trip: Vision 5D can read Pascal scene state and extract original provenance from metadata.vision5d. Edits in Pascal update position/geometry but metadata.vision5d persists unchanged.

coordinate_system.vision5d: Right-handed: X (east), Y (north), Z (up). Unit: meters (from DWG)
coordinate_system.pascal: Right-handed: X (east), Y (up/height), Z (north). Unit: meters
coordinate_system.conversion: Vision5D(x, y, z) → Pascal(x, z, y). No scale factor needed.

unit_conversion.note: Both systems use meters. No conversion needed for the 45x45 project.
